address: 150 Heaton Park Road, Newcastle Upon Tyne, NE6 5NR, United Kingdom
bio: Named after chef-owner Lindsay’s boyhood dog, this intimate, personally run restaurant has a quirky narrow shape, art by a member of the family on the walls and rustic wooden tables. The seasonal set menu offers small plates with a light, modern touch. The wine list includes some interesting organic and biodynamic choices, and it’s worth going for the pairings....
